description: This file is a Makefile used for building and configuring the glibc package within a larger build system, specifically in the context of OpenWrt. It includes package metadata, configuration flags, build steps, and scripts for preparing, configuring, and cleaning the build environment.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain information such as LIBC_TYPE, LIBC_URL, LIBC_VERSION, and LIBC_SO_VERSION in the info.mk file within the toolchain directory.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates necessary build directories and runs the glibc configure script with specific options tailored for the target environment.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment by invoking default preparation steps and creating symbolic links for source directory management.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build directories and intermediate files to clean up the build environment.
